source: Frido official website taxonomy (myfrido.com) — master hierarchy for all marketplace mapping

statusLegend.listed: A real, verified Frido listing exists on Amazon and/or Flipkart for this SKU/keyword — ranked organically, sponsored, carrying a Bestseller badge, or brand-verified to exist.
statusLegend.not-listed: A brand-qualified search was run and Frido has no product that genuinely fits this category — a verified gap, not a research miss.
statusLegend.needs-verification: Evidence is incomplete, not yet researched, or a live check was blocked — never treat as absent until verified.
